card.name: The word absorption in interactions
card.fires_on: The word absorption (including its pieces such as Abs, abs, orption) when a drug, meal or resin is said to change how much of another drug is taken up from the gut.

modes.label: Absorption after change verbs
modes.description: The word absorption right after words like reduce, decrease, delayed, enhance or slower.
modes.example: Famotidine can reduce the<< absorption>> of other drugs, due to its effect

modes.label: Split-up absorption
modes.description: Pieces of absorption or malabsorption when the word is broken into parts or written in capitals.

card.writes: It pushes toward gut and food words such as meals, food and obstruct, which fits talk of uptake in the stomach and bowel.
card.plain: It lights up on the word absorption when a label describes how food or another drug changes the uptake of a medicine.
